(Currently Amended) A composition, comprising: cavity-generating particles; a thermally conductive binder, wherein the binder is a premixed solder paste; and a solvent, wherein the solvent is not epoxy based.

(Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein the composition is applied to an electronic component surface, which is specifically a silicon chip.

(Currently Amended) The composition of claim 2, wherein the solvent is removed during application to the electronic component surface, and the composition achieves enhanced boiling properties on the surface.
